hooks.name: Validate Lambda handler changes
hooks.description: Requires focused local validation and a complete Lambda Console handoff after handler saves.

action.prompt: A ProofStack Lambda handler changed. Run its focused local pytest without AWS credentials or network access. Then apply the lambda-console-handoff skill: include the standalone source path, environment variables, least-privilege IAM actions/resources, matching API Gateway HTTP API v2 event, expected result and side effect, exact local test result, and ordered AWS Console steps. Do not provide cloud CLI or infrastructure-as-code instructions.
